title: Config subtree ordering, gating, attribute grouping, parents, abstract URIs
scenario: 1) getConfigRootChildren with entityTypes (2), empty relationTypes, sources (1). 2) Entity type with attributes, matchGroups, cleanseConfig, unmerge and no hidden config: expand it. 3) Attributes folder with 'b','A','c' of nested/reference/simple kinds. 4) Abstract A, concrete B extends A, C extends B, unrelated D, plus a cyclic extendsTypeURI pair. 5) getConfigTreeItemParent for ['entityTypes',0] and a length-1 path.
expected: 1) Entity Types (2) then Sources (1) in SECTIONS order, no empty folder, labels carry '(count)'. 2) Browse Entities first, then sections in code order; absent Hidden Config not emitted. 3) Nested, reference, simple groups, each case-insensitively alphabetical, jsonPath keeps original array index. 4) A returns [B, C] transitively; concrete returns itself; D excluded; cycle terminates. 5) Parent is the Entity Types (n) folder with tenantL3Uri; undefined for root-level paths.

title: Config and tree node id and contextValue scheme, tenant-scoped uniqueness
scenario: 1) Create ConfigTreeItem for folder, item, attributesFolder under relationTypes and entityBrowser, with and without tenant URI. 2) getConfigRootChildren with tenant URI A and B for the same model, compare ids. 3) Build TenantNode, BusinessConfigFolderNode, HistoryFolderNode, GitFolderNode for the same names in two envs.
expected: 1) contextValue is reltio.folder.<type> or reltio.item.<type>; relationType attribute nodes get '.relationType'; id is '<uri>|<path>' (plus '|browseEntities'). 2) Same jsonPath gives different ids per tenant URI; children inherit tenantL3Uri. 3) Ids use tenant:, businessConfig:, history:, gitFolder: prefixes; same tenant in two envs gives different ids; History contextValue gets '.empty' at zero snapshots.

title: Environment and tenant node values and lazy tree item commands
scenario: 1) EnvironmentNode for each combo of isAuthorized, canBrowserLogin and the 4 EStates. 2) TenantNode for hasL3 true/false, isGitBound, branch set, stale local unauthenticated, each TState, with vscode stub tenantSingleClickOpen true/false. 3) resolveTreeItem with entityBrowser ConfigTreeItem, plain ConfigTreeItem, HistorySnapshotNode, TenantNode.
expected: 1) contextValue reltio.environment.{authorized|unauthorized}[.oauthReady|.oauthBlocked], '.noTenants' only for E_AUTHED_NO_TENANTS; description/tooltip follow eState; id 'env:<name>'. 2) contextValue reltio.tenant[.l3][.gitbound]; description '(local)' when stale and unauthed else TState hint plus branch marker; command reltio.fetchL3 for T_NO_L3 else reltio.openL3, absent when setting false. 3) entityBrowser gets reltio.browseEntities, config items reltio.revealInEditor, snapshots vscode.open with fileUri; existing command not overwritten.

source: src/tree/multiTenantTreeProvider.ts getChildren (root, environment) ; src/tree/multiTenantTreeProvider.ts getChildren (TenantNode) ; src/tree/multiTenantTreeProvider.ts gitChildren ; src/tree/multiTenantTreeProvider.ts scheduleTreeRefresh / onL3DocumentChanged
title: Tree provider children, git source ordering and debounced refresh
scenario: 1) Provider with stub EnvironmentManager (2 envs, tenants) and TokenStore token for one env: getChildren() then getChildren(envNode). 2) Expand TenantNode with hasL3 true/false, normal env and env with GIT_SOURCE_TOKEN. 3) Stub getGitSources with folders [DP/dp_lif], [DP], [] and several labels: git env node and GitFolderNode. 4) onL3DocumentChanged 5 times within 150 ms for BusinessConfig.json and once for notes.txt.
expected: 1) One EnvironmentNode per env with authorized flag from TokenStore; env children are TenantNodes with TState from uxState or T_NO_L3; unknown env returns []. 2) With L3: Business Config then Workflows; without L3: Workflows only; git tenants no Workflows. 3) Folders before configs, localeCompare sorted and de-duplicated; configs by label else tenantId; Expanded, default T_READY. 4) Exactly one change event after about 150 ms; notes.txt never triggers; businessconfig.json matches case-insensitively.

title: UX state derivation, global state ladder and context publishing
scenario: 1) deriveUxState with env having OAuth client and no token; with GIT_SOURCE_TOKEN via getToken; with token and tenants. 2) Authed env without tenants; tenant hasL3 but file not in openedL3Files; then add its l3FileUri. 3) Subscribe two UxStateBus listeners, fire(); call publish* with recording vscode stub.
expected: 1) No token + OAuth gives E_HAS_OAUTH_NO_SESSION; git source always E_READY; token with tenants E_READY; global G_NEEDS_AUTH when nothing authed. 2) G_NEEDS_TENANT, then T_L3_NEVER_OPENED with G_READY, then T_READY; tenantCount and envCount correct. 3) Listeners fire once with no payload; setContext reltio.uxState=<global> and reltio.workspaceSource=<source> (null when undefined); dispose stops events.

title: Recents persistence, production hosts parsing and status bar rendering
scenario: 1) Fake Memento: push 12 hosts then re-push the 5th; 12 tenants under host X, 1 under Y. 2) Save/load auth method 'browser', garbage string, opened L3 Set. 3) loadProductionHosts with CRLF, blank line, ' b.com ' then a rejecting read. 4) Render each GState plus G_READY (1 env/0 tenants, 1/1, 2/3). 5) render G_EMPTY with hasWorkspaceFolder false then true.
expected: 1) Newest first, no duplicate, capped at 10, per-host tenant lists independent. 2) Valid values round-trip; unknown loads undefined; empty Memento gives empty Set. 3) ['a.com','b.com'], cached after first read, failure yields [] without throwing. 4) Labels Add an environment, Sign in required, Add a tenant, Fetch L3 with matching commands; 'Reltio: N env(s), M tenant(s)' pluralized; 1 env/0 tenants hides item. 5) Hidden without workspace folder; else 'Reltio: Add an environment' bound to reltio.launchSetupWizard.

title: Corrupt or missing L3 file yields empty Business Config without error
scenario: 1) Stub fs.readFile to throw, then to return invalid JSON; expand BusinessConfigFolderNode.
expected: 1) Children contain no config sections (History may appear); no exception propagates to the tree; text of an already-open editor document is preferred over disk.

title: Quick switch pick list, focus and auto-open, and tenant row guidance
scenario: 1) Stub scanEnvironments with 0 envs, then envs with 0, 1 and 3 tenants; capture showQuickPick items. 2) Pick an env with exactly one L3 tenant, then one with two; record executeCommand and openTextDocument. 3) Set UxState T_NO_L3, T_L3_NEVER_OPENED, T_READY and read TenantNode description/command.
expected: 1) Zero envs: 'No Reltio environments configured.' and no pick; items say 'No tenants', '1 tenant', '3 tenants'; cancel does nothing. 2) Both focus workbench.view.extension.reltioExplorer; only the single-L3 env opens its getL3Uri document. 3) 'L3 not fetched - click to fetch' (fetchL3), 'Open L3 to start editing' (openL3), then none; real-click flow is manual QA (Tier C).

title: Node fields never include tokens or secrets
scenario: 1) Construct nodes with token-like strings in env/tenant names and inspect tooltip, description, id, command arguments.
expected: 1) Only env name, tenant id, branch and fixed hint text appear; no token, credential or file contents are copied into node fields.

title: Large-scale tree performance: big model, many tenants, edit bursts
scenario: 1) Model with 5,000 entity types of 20 attributes each: time getConfigRootChildren and expanding one folder and one type. 2) Stub manager with 200 tenants, lookups delayed 5 ms: time getChildren(envNode). 3) onL3DocumentChanged 1,000 times in a tight loop.
expected: 1) Under 1 s (generous threshold); item count equals array length; ids unique. 2) 200 unique TenantNodes, time far below serial sum via Promise.all. 3) One change event total; debounce timer reset per call, not stacked.

source: src/ux/recents.ts pushRecentTenant / pushRecentHost ; src/ux/statusBar.ts flashSuccess / dispose ; src/tree/treeNodes.ts, multiTenantTreeProvider.ts onL3DocumentChanged
title: Resilience to bad stored data, status bar timer, and Windows paths
scenario: 1) Seed Memento with undefined and a non-array host key; push; compare original map reference. 2) Fake timers: flashSuccess then advance 1500 ms; dispose. 3) Build ConfigTreeItem ids from Uri.file('C:\ws\a b\BusinessConfig.json'); onL3DocumentChanged with a Windows-style path.
expected: 1) Push succeeds on empty store; stored map not mutated (copy written); only host and tenant strings stored. 2) Background warning ThemeColor then restored after 1500 ms; dispose disposes item. 3) Ids deterministic and unique with spaces and backslashes; refresh match uses lowercased path suffix; real UI across OSes is manual QA (Tier C).
